metric_definition.cer: Micro CER = total character-level Levenshtein edits / total normalized Gemini reference-name characters.
metric_definition.cer_comparison: Gemini medication name is the reference; Gemma medication name is the prediction.
metric_definition.exact_equality: Unicode NFKC + casefold + Arabic-Indic digit conversion + whitespace normalization.
metric_definition.warning: Agreement CER between Gemini and Gemma, not ground-truth OCR CER.
